method: Built only from aggregate tables published by the corpus authors; no individual record was downloaded or read. Two published tables listing full names (normalized_duplicate_names, unusual_names) were deleted unread (DATA_RULES DR-1). Built 9 Nov 2026 by scripts/build_profile_congonames.py

sources.name: Tshabu Ngandu, B., Cansa Kayembe, A. & Mpyana Mwamba, M. (2026), 'CongoNames Corpus: A Large-Scale Labeled Dataset of Congolese Personal Names', Data 11(7): 169, doi:10.3390/data11070169 (MDPI, CC BY 4.0)
sources.aggregates: Published aggregate tables in the authors' repository, reports/name_analysis/*.csv (https://github.com/bernard-ng/drc-names-corpus, commit a38c6a421754027418f085c6d05227e6f3d40138); the repository itself declares no licence
sources.underlying_data: National secondary-school examination result lists (palmarès) 2008-2023, DRC Ministry of Education; 8,053,983 records, 12 provinces

population_note: Secondary-school exam candidates (mostly adolescents and young adults), 2008-2023; not representative of older adults, of people who did not reach the exam, or of refugees specifically

structure.order_observed: In the exam lists the first token is mostly a Bantu name (nom) and the last token mostly a Christian/French given name (prénom): order nom, postnom, prénom

variant_pairs_observed.basis: all three in the first-token top 50 (58,229 / 20,600 / 14,157)
both in the first-token top 50 (16,052 / 11,265): w written w or u

never: No ethnicity, clan, tribe or religion pattern; province, sex and year only (BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md §2.4; C12)
